Today’s world feature · October 15, 2026

Japan does not see one “world.” It sees five different maps.

America can be an ally and a dream factory. China can be a neighbor, a civilization and a strategic worry—all at once. The same layered view reaches from Australia to Morocco, and from Europe to the Caribbean.
